name: Tropicália
summary: Tropicália or Tropicalism was a artistic, political, cultural and social movement that originated in Brazil and became popular in 1970s and 1980s during the Brazilian Military Dictatorship era.
description: Tropicália or Tropicalism was a artistic, political, cultural and social movement that originated in Brazil and became popular in 1970s and 1980s during the Brazilian Military Dictatorship era. The goal of Tropicalism was to oppose traditionalism disseminated by the military and the elite, uniting Brazilian cultural elements with foreign genres.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Individual Freedom, Democracy, Patriotism
